description: You are a law review editor auditing a Juris-M library of 10 court cases that were imported automatically with citation errors. Without being told which records are wrong, you must examine each case and fix ALL errors you find. Known error patterns: (1) Some SCOTUS cases incorrectly use 'F.2d' or 'F.3d' as the reporter — all cases in this library are United States Supreme Court decisions and should use 'U.S.' as the reporter. (2) Two cases have the court field set to a district court name ('USDC N.D. Ill.' or 'USDC E.D.N.Y.') — they are actually United States Supreme Court cases. (3) One case has an obviously wrong year in the date field. (4) Two cases have '999' as the first page number — this is a placeholder that must be corrected to the real first page. After fixing all errors: (5) Add the tag 'audited' to every case in the library. (6) Create a collection called 'Audited Cases' and add all 10 cases to it. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.

wrong_court_cases: Bivens v. Six Unknown Named Agents of Federal Bureau of Narcotics
